title: Green Beans in Tomato Sauce -- Greek Fasolakia
description:
Greek Fasolakia is a classic Mediterranean comfort food made with tender green beans slowly braised in a rich tomato sauce with potatoes, olive oil, onions, and garlic. This traditional vegan recipe is a staple in Greek homes and showcases how simple pantry ingredients can create an incredibly flavorful meal. Serve it with crusty bread, creamy feta cheese, and olives for an authentic Greek lunch or dinner.
https://www.dimitrasdishes.com/fasolakia-braised-green-beans/
ingredients: ½ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 medium red or yellow onion, finely chopped
1 (28-ounce) can crushed or whole peeled San Marzano tomatoes, pureed
3 Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut into wedges
Pinch of crushed red pepper flakes
directions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot or Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 8–10 minutes, or until soft and lightly golden.
Stir in the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, potatoes, green beans, salt, black pepper, crushed red pepper flakes, dried dill (if using), and water. Stir well to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low. Cover and simmer for about 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender and the green beans are almost fully cooked.

Remove the lid and increase the heat to medium. Continue cooking uncovered for 15–20 minutes (adding in the fresh dill, if using), stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and coats the vegetables.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed. Remove from the heat and stir in the fresh parsley.
Allow the fasolakia to rest for 10 minutes before serving to let the flavors develop.
Serve warm with feta cheese, crusty bread, and olives.
